parent_objective: execute measured scenario taxonomy over fixed 864-cell matrix
blocked_by: need measured execution before scenario taxonomy result audit
supersedes: direct scenario taxonomy result audit without execution

public_gates: M1731 must execute exactly the M1728 864-cell scenario taxonomy matrix
M1731 must join scenario_specs.json metadata into every episode row
M1731 must write episode, failure, state, scenario-family, hidden-dynamics, road-boundary, obstacle-timing, outcome, termination, profile-outcome, and scenario-family-outcome artifacts
M1731 must preserve unsupported-fault boundaries and not treat unsupported faults as covered
M1731 must not train replay PPO promote use private holdout change actor inputs tune profiles or rank controller families
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat unsupported faults as covered

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: executes fixed 864-cell scenario taxonomy after design-only admission
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public diagnostic scenario taxonomy execution only; no training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if selected metrics are non-finite
stop if required scenario aggregates are missing
stop if unsupported faults are treated as covered
fallback_plan: route to runner repair if execution plumbing fails
route to result audit if execution passes
route to taxonomy repair if metadata join fails
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1730 admits measured scenario taxonomy execution

admission_evidence: M1730 pre-registers execution artifacts, metadata joins, and unsupported-feature boundaries
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: scenario taxonomy execution runner or adapter if needed
M1731 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: scenario metadata and aggregate artifacts are present
execution pass/fail is recorded without interpreting profile rank

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1731 is a task-quality diagnostic execution and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: execution matrix preserves L1, L2-current-tiled, L2 history-window, L3-online, and L3-reset controls for later audit
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If scenario taxonomy outcomes are weak or dominated, record as task-quality evidence rather than self-ID failure.
allowed_claims: no training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1728 scenario taxonomy matrix can be executed as a fixed public diagnostic run with complete scenario aggregates and preserved unsupported-feature boundaries.
success_criteria: hidden dynamics, road boundary, obstacle timing, outcome, termination, profile-outcome, and scenario-family-outcome aggregates exist
scenario metadata fields are preserved in episode rows
training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes ranking and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: unsupported faults are treated as covered
training replay PPO private holdout promotion actor-input changes or profile ranking occurs

result.dominant_error_message: failed to sample an obstacle scenario matching the configured filters

decision_rule: M1731 passes as execution plumbing if the 864 scenario taxonomy episodes complete with finite metrics, zero failures, complete metadata aggregates, and no unsupported-feature boundary violation. Result interpretation is deferred to the next audit.
